not_established: No host qualification: Windows native/Tailscale and Linux Docker are unexercised.
No physical-device, screen-reader or assistive-technology testing.
No independent security or accessibility review.
No distribution: dist/brrpbrrp is a development build and the alpha.7 archives under dist/releases remain historical schema-14 packages.
No G0-G8 gate is passed and no publication approval exists.

properties: a snapshot read in one transaction, not a query over moving state
only conversations the account can read *now*, resolved through the same rules as a message list
no credentials: password hashes, sessions, second-factor secrets, recovery codes and stored filenames are structurally absent from the account block
bounded on the write (50,000 messages, 2,000 attachments, 256 MiB) and the bound is recorded in the file and in the interface
gated on recent strong authentication, and authority is re-read at download as well as at build
a queued export does not run for an erased account
a seven-day server lifetime, and the member can delete theirs sooner
member_export.evidence: internal/api/export_test.go covers the membership, credential, bound, key-identity, ownership and fresh-authentication properties. An existing route-enumeration test caught the new recent-auth route when it was added.
